A father put his own son in the fire, and the fire refused to burn him. As the story goes, the demon king Hiranyakashipu wanted the whole world to worship only him. But his little son Prahlad kept chanting Narayana.
The king tried everything. Snakes. Elephants. Cliffs. Prahlad just smiled and kept chanting. So the king called his sister Holika. She had a shawl that no fire could burn.

Holika sat in a giant bonfire with Prahlad on her lap. Wait, what happened? The wind blew. The magic shawl flew off Holika, and wrapped itself around Prahlad. Holika burned. Prahlad walked out, still chanting.
That's why we light the Holika bonfire the night before Holi. Faith walks through fire. Comment Narayana if your faith has ever been tested.
